messages.text: Turn a product launch's research, architecture decisions, runbooks, validation results, and meeting notes into a handoff collection for the incoming team lead.

I will build a private local collection index from only the authorized sources, preserving exact versions, access and freshness state, human decision ownership, duplicates, disputes, retention, and blockers.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I wrote outputs/knowledge-collection-index.json and rendered outputs/knowledge-curator-handoff.md. The handoff remains blocked by the unresolved write-path dispute and unavailable restricted security evidence.
